name: East Lytelthorpe Outpost
title: East Lytelthorpe Outpost
summary: A starter outpost destroyed by Martine in The First Strike; 'a long row of Empyrean Pillars leads to the nearby Forgotten Temple' (Ercel, Riflyffa the Shopkeeper; portals to Bluespire and the Forgotten Temple). In the kit: the Life Stone under a huge oak canopy, a well, cottages and an apple tree, the 28 m ruined monument tower (top z 67.9), the shattered Destroyed Portal to Bluespire crackling with tesla lightning and pink arc fountains 85 m north-west, and eight 4.6 m stone pillars marching 350 m east toward the Forgotten Temple.

shots.standingOrder: Skim west 4 m over the grass along the row of Empyrean pillars toward the outpost's monument tower silhouetted against the low golden sun; keep 2 m from every pillar and bush.
